name: Aldous's Letter
description: The back of an old Saltmarrow tide-table, folded twice, AGATHE LORN, PROVOST on the outside in Brother Aldous Wren's hand, spelled wrong. He wrote it slowly on his bench for a long time instead of getting in a boat. 'Don't read it. You'd only be disappointed. It's mostly apologising.' For the Provost of Kindleby.
